title: Allah Janay Sain Zainab Ne, Kevain Qaid Nibhaayi
body:
Kevain Safr Kittay, Baaj Bhiraawan, Hy Dard Sataayi
1)Abid Nu, Pathran De Wich, Kadi Safraan Ch Sakina, Nu Kadi Bhaina Nu
Qaidi Hathaan De Nal, Saambh Di Reh Gayi, Zahra Di Kamaayi
2)Apne Hi, Ghar De Wich Jis Dum, Aakay Abdulla Ne Pucheya, Ke Tu Bibi Kon Ay
Bas Ronday Hoya, Khaak Utha Ke, Zainab Ne Uraayi
3)Zaalim De, Labaan Utay Aaya, Jadon Naa Fatimah Zahra, Da Bharay Majme Wich
Maa Di Azmat Layi, Khutbay Parhdi, Dhi Zahra Di Aayi
4)Amri De, Naal Mil Ke, Jevain Rondi Ay Koi Dhi, Aiway Zainab Royi
Jadon Maa Di Rida, Waqt Rihaai, Gal Sain Ne Laayi
5)Jadh Wi Suraj, Sawairay Charda Si, Aap Jukh Jaandi Si Wich Haal-e Rako De’ Zainab
Enjh Baalan Uthay, Rayi Chaawan Kardi, Hy Zahra Di Jaayi
6)Aj Wi Saqlain, Janaab E Mehdi, Ona Raawan Ton Hataande, Oday Pairaan De Nishan
Jinna Rawaan Uthay, Shaamiyan Zainab, Kalli Qaidi Turaayi
